H1.basis: No verified plant mask or correspondence-defined leaf ROI: increased target pixel coverage cannot be established. Ray angles are not reconstruction-accuracy measurements.
H1.required_followup: Validate foreground/leaf ROI correspondences and target pixel coverage; obtain reconstruction accuracy or a reference surface.

H2.basis: Descriptive full-scene recovered-feature evidence only. Thresholds are declared diagnostics, not universal geometry/accuracy limits. Blocks share frames/tracks; not independent population samples. Primary H2 decision uses same-local-segment pairs at <=3 s lag. COLMAP min triangulation angle and successful-registration selection censor unreconstructed/weak observations; NOT_SUPPORTED applies only to recovered-feature evidence.
H2.required_followup: Repeat within verified local target ROIs and independent acquisitions; examine within-segment and temporal-gap sensitivity.

H3.basis: A mixed reconstructed track with non-collinear rays is an actual geometric correspondence, not merely potential overlap. Fewer than four independently observed local images is insufficient for a supported H3 judgment. Target-specific gain and final surface accuracy remain untested.
H3.required_followup: Separate plant/background tracks and compare global-only versus global+local target geometry under aligned gauges.

H4.basis: Cross-scale verified SIFT size ratios and match/registration rates are observed, but real overlap, motion blur, texture repetition and non-rigidity are not controlled. Failure alone cannot identify a scale mechanism. Verified-pair scale ratios are survivor-biased.
H4.required_followup: Audit actual overlap in failed pairs; compare fixed overlap with scale-normalized matching, sharpness-matched pairs and transition-frame ablations.

population_inference: No independent-pair p-values; purposive pilot selection is not a population sample.
limitations: No plant foreground masks; all geometric conclusions concern recovered full-scene features.
No metric scale or known gravity; absolute baselines cannot be pooled across videos.
Segment labels are proxy evidence, with unregistered temporal inference explicitly marked.
Pair and time-block statistics remain correlated; no independent-pair significance test or causal blur claim.
8-bit sharpness/exposure diagnostics of HDR source are not calibrated radiometry.
